ErrorResponse.description: Response envelope for errors. `error` is required; `data` is absent.

request_id.description: Unique trace ID of this request; include it when reporting issues so logs can be located.

result_label.description: Destination label key the composed value is written to. Must match `^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$`.

template.description: Go `text/template` string (1–500 characters) rendered against the event struct — e.g. `{{.Title}}`, `{{.Description}}`, `{{.Labels.key}}`. Example: `{{.Labels.region}}-{{.Labels.env}}`.

override.description: When `false` (default) the rule is skipped if `result_label` already exists on the event; when `true` the existing value is overwritten.

drop_labels.description: Label names to remove from the event (at least one), given without the `labels.` prefix.

source_field.description: Source field to extract from. Must be `title`, `description`, or a label key prefixed with `labels.` (e.g. `labels.env`).

result_label.description: Destination label key the extracted value is written to. Must match `^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$`.

pattern.description: Regular expression (RE2) applied to the source value; may be wrapped in `/.../`. All capture groups are joined with a space and written to `result_label`. Nothing is written when the expression does not match, has no capture group, or the first group is empty. Exactly one of `pattern` and `g_json` must be set.

g_json.description: GJSON path (a leading `$.` is ignored) used when the source value is a JSON string, e.g. `host.name`. If the source value is not valid JSON the rule is skipped; if the path does not exist an empty string is written. Exactly one of `pattern` and `g_json` must be set.

override.description: When `false` (default) the rule is skipped if `result_label` already exists on the event; when `true` the existing value is overwritten.

result_labels.description: Label keys to fill from the lookup result (at least one). For `schema` they are normally the schema's `result_labels`; for `api` they are sent to the API as `result_label_keys`.

mapping_type.description:
Lookup source.
- `schema` (default): look up a row in the mapping schema `schema_id` using the event's values of the schema's `source_labels`; the rule does nothing if any source label is missing or no row matches.
- `api`: call the mapping API `api_id` with the event; runs for alert events only.

schema_id.description: Mapping schema ID (MongoDB ObjectID hex). Required when `mapping_type` is `schema`.

api_id.description: Mapping API ID (MongoDB ObjectID hex). Required when `mapping_type` is `api`.

override.description: When `false` (default) the rule is skipped if every label in `result_labels` already exists, and otherwise only the missing labels are filled. When `true` all `result_labels` are overwritten with the lookup result.

max_times.description: Total notifications sent in this level, including the first, 0–6; `0` and `1` both notify once.

notify_step.description: Minutes between repeat notifications in this level, 0.5–120, kept to one decimal place. Used only when `max_times` is greater than 1.

escalate_window.description: Minutes to wait after this level's first notification before escalating to the next level, 0–720. Ignored on the last level.

force_escalate.description: When true, escalate even after the incident has been acknowledged (`Processing`). When false, escalation stops once the incident is acknowledged. Closed or snoozed incidents never escalate.

account_id.description: Owning account ID.

channel_id.description: Channel the rule belongs to.

priority.description: Evaluation order from `0` to `200`: lower values are evaluated first, ties broken by creation time. The first enabled rule whose time windows and filters match a new incident takes it.

aggr_window.description: Delay in seconds, 0–3600, before the first notification for a newly assigned incident is sent; `0` notifies immediately.

time_filters.description: Recurring time windows during which the rule can match; empty means at any time.

filters.description: Incident conditions (OR of AND groups), matched against the incident the alert was grouped into. Empty means the rule matches every incident in the channel.

status.description: Rule status: `enabled` means active, `disabled` means paused, `deleted` is soft-deleted (possible only from the detail endpoint; lists never return deleted rules).

template_id.description: Notification template ID (24-character hex); see `POST /template/list`.

updated_by.description: Member ID that last updated the rule.

deleted_at.description: Deletion time, Unix timestamp in seconds. Omitted unless the rule is soft-deleted; deleted rules are excluded from list responses.

created_at.description: Creation time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

EscalateTarget.description: Notification target. At least one of `person_ids`, `team_ids`, `schedule_to_role_ids`, or `emails` must be set, together with either `by` or `webhooks`.

person_ids.description: Member IDs to notify directly; obtain them from `POST /member/list`. Every ID must exist.

team_ids.description: Team IDs whose members are notified; obtain them from `POST /team/list`. Each team must have at least one member.

schedule_to_role_ids.description: Notify whoever is on call: keys are schedule IDs (from `POST /schedule/list`) written as strings, values are the role IDs on that schedule. Each value must be non-empty.

emails.description: Email addresses of account members; each address is resolved to the member who owns it when the level fires.

by.description: Personal notification channels for the people in this target, per incident severity. Required unless `webhooks` is set; returned as `null` when not set.

follow_preference.description: When true, each person is notified through the channels in their own notification preferences for the incident's severity, and `critical`, `warning` and `info` are ignored.

critical.description: Channels used when the incident severity is `Critical`: `sms`, `voice`, `email`, `push`, or a direct message through an IM app integration written as `<app>:<integration_id>`, where `<app>` is `feishu_app`, `dingtalk_app`, `wecom_app`, `slack_app` or `teams_app` and `<integration_id>` is the ID of that IM integration. Other values return `InvalidParameter`.

warning.description: Channels used when the incident severity is `Warning`; same values as `critical`.

info.description: Channels used when the incident severity is `Info`; same values as `critical`.

webhooks.description: Group chats to notify through robots or IM apps. Required unless `by` is set; returned as `null` when not set.

type.description:
Delivery type:
- `feishu`, `dingtalk`, `wecom`, `slack`, `telegram`, `zoom`: a group robot (incoming webhook) of that IM.
- `feishu_app`, `dingtalk_app`, `slack_app`, `teams_app`: group chats reached through the corresponding IM app integration.

settings.description: Type-specific settings, such as the robot's webhook token or the app's chat IDs; `feishu_app` and `dingtalk_app` require it. To see the exact shape for a type, configure one in the console and read it back with `POST /channel/escalate/rule/info`.

ExportStatusPageSubscribersRequest.description: Parameters for exporting a status page subscriber list.

page_id.description: Status page ID; obtain it from `GET /status-page/list`.

component_ids.description: Optional component IDs to filter subscribers by.

ExportedStatusPageSubscriberItem.description: A status page subscriber, as returned by the subscriber list and export endpoints.

recipient.description: Subscriber recipient: email address for public pages, user ID for internal pages.

method.description: Subscription notification method. `email` is email subscription (public pages); `im` is IM subscription (internal pages). Determined by the page type.

components.description: Components the subscriber follows; each item carries only `component_id` and `name`. Empty when `all` is `true`.

all.description: Whether the subscriber is subscribed to all components.

locale.description: Preferred locale for notifications. Omitted when empty.

progress.description: `Processing` when this acknowledgement moved the incident from `Triggered` to `Processing`; omitted when the incident was already `Processing`.

comment.description: Form summary recorded as a timeline comment. Omitted when no acknowledgement form summary was submitted.

images.description: Images from the acknowledgement form, recorded on the timeline entry only. Omitted when none were submitted.

FeedDetailIncidentAssign.description: Detail payload for `i_assign`. Extends `AssignedTo` with the set of target member IDs.

to.description: Member IDs that received the assignment.

FeedDetailIncidentAssign.title: i_assign

mute_reply.description: Whether replies to this comment are muted.

comment_type_id.description: ObjectID of the account-level comment type attached to the comment.

comment_type.description: Name and color of the attached comment type, resolved at read time; omitted when no comment type is attached or it no longer exists.

integration_id.description: Integration ID that executed the action.

source_incidents.description: Incidents merged into the target; present on the target incident's entry.

target_incident.description: Incident this incident was merged into; present on each source incident's entry.

owner_id.description: Not set by incident merges, which never change the owner; present only on older entries.

title.description: New title the merge set on the target incident; present only on the target's entry and only when the title changed.

remove_source_incidents.description: `true` when the source incidents were permanently deleted after the merge.

source_responders.description: Member IDs that were responders on the source incidents, for reference; they are not added to the target's responders.

max_changes.description: Maximum state changes allowed within the window.

mute_mins.description: Mute duration in minutes once flapping is detected.

severity.description: Severity of the incident when it was created.

reporter_email.description: Email of the reporter when the incident was created externally.

msg_id.description: Upstream message ID returned by the delivery channel.

fire_type.description: Whether this is the first fire or a refire. `fire`: the first notification for this escalation layer; `refire`: a repeat notification to the same layer when the incident remains unhandled, sent at the layer's notify interval and capped by the layer's maximum refire count.

layer_idx.description: Escalation level index used for this notification.

reason.description: Free-text reason passed as `reason` to `POST /incident/reopen`; omitted when none was given.

field_name.description: Name of the custom field that was updated.

to.description: New value of the custom field. Type depends on the field definition.

from.description:
Source that triggered the resolve.
| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `voice` | Phone-call (voice DTMF) action. |
| `console` | Console (Web UI) action. |
| `card` | IM notification card button (DingTalk/Feishu/Slack/Teams). |
| `wcard` | WeCom notification card button. |
| `event` | Event-driven: auto-close when all related alerts recover to Ok, or a close synced from an external ITSM system. |
| `autorslv` | Auto-resolve: closed by the system after no new alerts within the channel's auto-resolve timeout. |
| `autorefresh` | Card auto-refresh (reserved; never appears on resolve feeds). |
| `escalation` | Escalation flow (reserved; never appears on resolve feeds). |

comment.description: Form summary recorded as a timeline comment on resolution. Omitted when no resolve form summary was submitted.

images.description: Images from the resolve form, recorded on the timeline entry only. Omitted when none were submitted.

progress.description: `Triggered` when removing this acknowledgement returned the incident to `Triggered` (no responder still acknowledged); omitted otherwise.

snoozedBefore.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) at which the cancelled snooze would have ended.

integration_id.description: Integration ID that hosts the war room chat group.

plugin_type.description: Plugin type of the IM integration: `feishu_app` (Feishu), `dingtalk_app` (DingTalk), `wecom_app` (WeCom), or `slack_app` (Slack).

share_link.description: Shareable join link for the war room.

integration_id.description: Integration ID that hosted the war room chat group.

unlink_only.description: `true` when the war room was only unlinked from the incident (`unlink_only` request) and the group was not dissolved. Omitted otherwise.

plugin_type.description: Plugin type of the IM integration: `feishu_app` (Feishu), `dingtalk_app` (DingTalk), `wecom_app` (WeCom), or `slack_app` (Slack).

FeedItem.description: A single alert activity feed entry. The `detail` field is discriminated by `type`; see the per-type `FeedDetailAlert*` schemas.

ref_id.description: ObjectID of the alert this entry references.

detail.description: Type-specific payload; the concrete shape is determined by `type`. May be `null` for entries stored without detail.

account_id.description: ID of the account that owns the alert.

creator_id.description: Member ID of the creator. 0 for system-generated entries.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete time, Unix epoch milliseconds. Omitted when not deleted.

via.description: Surface that wrote the entry on a user's behalf; currently only `ai_sre`. Omitted when a user created the entry directly.

agent_session_id.description: AI SRE session that produced the entry. Omitted when no agent wrote it.

key.description: Field to match. Which built-in keys are allowed depends on the rule type and is listed on the field that holds the conditions; any `labels.<name>` key (for example `labels.env`) is always accepted. An unknown key returns `InvalidParameter`. When the alert or incident has no value for the key, `IN` does not match and `NOTIN` matches.

oper.description: Match operator, case-sensitive. `IN`: matches when the field value matches any entry in `vals`. `NOTIN`: matches when it matches none of them.

vals.description: Values to compare, at least one. Each entry is matched as: an exact string; a wildcard pattern when it contains `*` or `?` (must match the whole value); a regular expression when wrapped in slashes, such as `/^db-/` (may match anywhere in the value); an IP range written `cidr:<network>`, such as `cidr:203.0.113.0/24`; or a numeric comparison `num:<op>:<number>` with `lt`, `le`, `gt` or `ge`, such as `num:gt:90`.

is_disabled.description: When true, flapping detection is turned off.

max_changes.description: Max state changes allowed within `in_mins`, 2–100. When omitted or `0`, all three values fall back to the defaults: 4 changes, `in_mins` 60, `mute_mins` 120.

mute_mins.description: Mute duration in minutes after flapping is detected.

GetWarRoomDetailRequest.description: Parameters for retrieving a war room's live detail.

integration_id.description: IM integration ID that hosts the war room.

chat_id.description: Chat ID of the IM group hosting the war room; obtain it from `POST /incident/war-room/list`.

GetWebhookHistoryDetailRequest.description: Lookup parameters for a single webhook delivery record.

event_id.description: `event_id` of a record returned by `POST /webhook/history/list`. It starts with the delivery date (`YYYYMMDD`); an ID without that prefix fails the request.

integration_id.description: Integration ID the event belongs to; available in the items returned by `POST /webhook/history/list`.

method.description:
Grouping method:
- `n`: no grouping; every new alert opens its own incident.
- `p`: rule-based grouping by the keys in `equals` and `cases`; requires the Standard license or higher.
- `i`: intelligent grouping by content similarity (see `i_keys`, `i_score_threshold`); requires the Pro license.

equals.description: Key sets for rule-based (`p`) grouping, up to 5 sets. A new alert joins an active incident when every key of any one set has the same value on both. Keys: `title`, `description`, `severity`, or `labels.<name>`; each set must be non-empty. With `p`, at least one of `equals` or `cases` is required.

items.description: Conditional grouping override: stored alerts matching `if` are grouped by `equals` instead of the top-level grouping keys.

if.description: AND-ed match conditions evaluated against stored alert fields.

equals.description: Grouping keys for matching alerts. Supported values: `title`, `description`, `severity`, or any `labels.<name>`.

all_equals_required.description: When true, a key set matches only if every key in it is present on the alert. When false, missing keys compare as empty, but at least one key of the set must be present.

time_window.description: Grouping time window in minutes. Default max is 1440 minutes (24 h); extended accounts may allow up to 43200 minutes (30 days).

window_type.description: Window type, default `tumbling`. `tumbling` is a fixed window counted from incident creation — once it expires, new alerts open a new incident; `sliding` is a sliding window counted from the incident's most recent alert, extended each time a new alert merges in.

storm_threshold.description: Legacy single storm threshold; used only when `storm_thresholds` is empty and the value is greater than 1. `0` disables it.

storm_thresholds.description: Alert counts at which an incident storm event fires: when the number of alerts merged into one incident reaches a threshold, a storm notification is sent. Up to 5 values, each at least 2; duplicates are removed and values are sorted.

i_keys.description: Fields used by intelligent (`i`) grouping, up to 10: `title`, `description`, `severity`, or `labels.<name>`. Empty uses `title`, `description`, `labels.service` and `labels.resource`.

i_score_threshold.description: Minimum similarity, 0.5–1, for intelligent grouping to merge an alert into an existing incident. Omitted or `0` uses 0.9.

src.description: Image source. Either an `img_` upload token or an `http(s)` URL.

href.description: Optional link the image points to.

alt.description: Alternative text shown when the image cannot be displayed; empty when not set.

recipient.description: Email address (for public pages) or user ID (for internal pages).

component_ids.description: Component IDs the subscriber should receive notifications for.

change_ids.description: Specific event IDs the subscriber should receive notifications for.

all.description: When `true`, the subscriber receives notifications for all components and events, and `component_ids`/`change_ids` are ignored. Must be `true` when both lists are empty.

locale.description: Preferred locale for notifications. Defaults to the request locale when omitted.

ImportStatusPageSubscribersRequest.description: Parameters for bulk-importing subscribers. Each subscriber must have a non-empty `recipient` (≤255 chars) and subscribe to at least one component, change, or set `all: true`.

page_id.description: Target status page ID; obtain it from `GET /status-page/list`.

method.description: Subscription method. `email` is only valid for public pages; `im` is only valid for internal pages.

subscribers.description: Subscribers to import. Each recipient's existing subscriptions on this page are replaced; an empty or omitted list does nothing.

Triggered.description: Incidents started in the last 30 days that are still `Triggered` (not yet acknowledged).

Processing.description: Incidents started in the last 30 days that are `Processing` (acknowledged, not yet closed).

IncidentFeedItem.description: Single incident timeline entry. The `detail` field is discriminated by `type`; see the per-type `FeedDetail*` schemas.

ref_id.description: ID of the incident the entry belongs to; equals the requested `incident_id`.

detail.description: Type-specific payload. The concrete shape is determined by `type`; `null` when the entry has no structured detail.

count.description: Number of action items converted to follow-ups.

work_item_ids.description: IDs of the converted work items.

titles.description: Titles of the converted work items, in the same order as `work_item_ids`.

post_mortem_id.description: ID of the post-mortem the follow-ups are bound to; empty when the incident has no post-mortem.

account_id.description: ID of the account that owns this record; the same for every record returned to one `app_key`.

creator_id.description: User ID of the actor. `0` means system-generated.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete timestamp in milliseconds. Zero if not deleted.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp in milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp in milliseconds.

via.description: `ai_sre` when AI SRE performed the action on behalf of `creator_id`; omitted for direct actions.

agent_session_id.description: ID of the AI SRE session that performed the action; present only when `via` is `ai_sre` and a session was recorded.

IncidentFeedType.description:
Incident timeline entry type. Each value identifies one lifecycle event; the matching `detail` payload shape is determined by this field. Incident types are prefixed with `i_`.

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `i_new` | Incident Created: A new incident was created automatically or manually. |
| `i_assign` | Assigned: Incident was assigned to responders. |
| `i_a_rspd` | Responder Added: Additional responders joined the incident. |
| `i_notify` | Notification dispatched through a channel at a specific escalation level. |
| `i_storm` | Alert storm threshold reached on the incident. |
| `i_snooze` | Notifications snoozed for a given duration. |
| `i_wake` | Snooze cancelled and notifications resumed. |
| `i_ack` | Acknowledged: Responder confirmed they are working on the incident. |
| `i_unack` | Acknowledgement removed. |
| `i_comm` | Comment: Responder logged progress or key information. |
| `i_rslv` | Resolved: Incident was marked as resolved. |
| `i_reopen` | Reopened: Resolved incident was reopened, possibly due to recurrence. |
| `i_merge` | Merged: Multiple related incidents were merged into one. |
| `i_r_title` | Title updated. |
| `i_r_desc` | Description updated. |
| `i_r_impact` | Impact updated. |
| `i_r_rc` | Root cause updated. |
| `i_r_rsltn` | Resolution updated. |
| `i_r_severity` | Severity Changed: Incident severity level was adjusted. |
| `i_r_field` | Custom field value updated. |
| `i_m_flapping` | Incident muted by flapping detection. |
| `i_m_reply` | Mute reply marker on a comment. |
| `i_custom` | Action: Automated action or script was triggered. |
| `i_wr_create` | War Room Created: Chat group was created for collaborative response. |
| `i_wr_delete` | War room chat group deleted. |
| `i_auto_refresh` | Card auto-refresh event posted back to the timeline. |
| `i_wi_created` | Work Item Created: An Action or Follow-up was created. |
| `i_wi_updated` | Work Item Updated: Title, description, status, or priority was changed. |
| `i_wi_assignees` | Work Item Assignees Changed: Assignees were updated. |
| `i_wi_completed` | Work Item Completed: An assignee marked the work item complete. |
| `i_wi_converted` | Work Item Converted: An Action was converted to a Follow-up. |
| `i_wi_bound` | Work Item Bound: A converted Follow-up was bound to a post-mortem. |
| `i_wi_deleted` | Work Item Deleted: An Action or Follow-up was soft-deleted. |
| `i_wi_auto_converted` | Work Items Auto-converted: Closing the incident converted its unfinished action items to follow-ups. |
| `a_merge` | Alert Merged: An alert was merged into an existing incident. |

account_id.description: Account ID that owns the incident.

channel_id.description: Channel ID. 0 for standalone incidents.

team_id.description: ID of the team that owns the incident's channel. 0 when the channel has no team.

integration_id.description: First integration associated with the incident.

integration_ids.description: IDs of all integrations contributing alerts to this incident; `null` for incidents without integrations, such as manually created ones.

integration_types.description: Plugin types of all contributing integrations (see `integration_type`); `null` when there are none.

dedup_key.description: Deduplication key used to coalesce alerts.

equals_md5.description: MD5 hash used for content-equality checks.

start_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the incident started.

end_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the incident ended. 0 if still active.

last_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the most recent update.

ack_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the incident was first acknowledged. 0 if unacknowledged.

close_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the incident was closed. 0 if still open.

creator_id.description: Member ID that created the incident. 0 if auto-created by the system.

closer_id.description: Member ID that closed the incident. 0 if auto-closed.

owner_id.description: Primary owner member ID. 0 if none.

incident_status.description: Current incident status, derived from alert statuses.

progress.description: Incident progress. `Triggered` means fired and unacknowledged; `Processing` means acknowledged and being handled (un-acknowledging moves it back to `Triggered`); `Closed` means resolved.

num.description: Short display identifier; not guaranteed unique.

frequency.description: Frequency bucket for recurrence analysis: `frequent` or `rare`.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete timestamp (seconds). Zero if not deleted.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (seconds).

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (seconds).

snoozed_before.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) until which notifications are snoozed. 0 if not snoozed.

group_method.description: Alert grouping method: `i` intelligent, `p` pattern, `n` none.

ever_muted.description: Whether the incident has ever been silenced.

has_unfinished_work_item.description: `true` when the incident still has at least one action item or follow-up that is neither `done` nor `cancelled`.

labels.description: Labels on the incident, propagated from alerts or set at creation.

fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field name.

assigned_to.description: Current assignment target. Always present; for an incident that was never assigned, `type` and `id` are empty and `assigned_at` is `0`.

reporter_email.description: Reporter email for manually created incidents.

alert_cnt.description: Total count of alerts merged into this incident.

active_alert_cnt.description: Count of alerts currently in Critical/Warning/Info state.

alert_event_cnt.description: Total raw alert event count across all merged alerts.

alerts.description: Not returned by the incident endpoints; present only in notification template and custom action payloads.

owner.description: Owner member info. May be deprecated.

account_name.description: Always an empty string in API responses; filled only when the incident is rendered for notifications.

account_locale.description: Always an empty string in API responses; filled only when the incident is rendered for notifications.

account_time_zone.description: Always an empty string in API responses; filled only when the incident is rendered for notifications.

channel_status.description: Status of the channel: `enabled`, `disabled`, or `deleted`. Empty string when the record has no channel or the channel no longer exists.

detail_url.description: Web console URL for the incident.

links.description: Channel-level link integrations rendered for this incident.

integration_type.description: Plugin type of the incident's first integration (see `integration_types` for all). Open set, for example `prometheus.alert` or `monit.alert`; `POST /integration/type/list` returns the full list. Omitted when the incident has no integration or the endpoint does not fill it.

post_mortem_id.description: Associated post-mortem ID, if any. One incident can only link to a single post-mortem.

images.description: Images attached to the incident; `null` when there are none. Tokens starting with `img_` are returned as download URLs.

manual_overrides.description: Fields edited manually and therefore no longer overwritten by merged alerts: `title`, `description`, `incident_severity`. `null` when none.

IncidentInfoRequest.description: Lookup parameters for a single incident. Supply either incident_id or num.

num.description: Short incident ID (the 6-character uppercased id shown in the UI). Not unique — resolves to the most recent match. Supply either incident_id or num.

items.description: Incident list for the current page.

total.description: Number of matching incidents, capped at 1,000. For `POST /incident/list-by-ids`, the number of incidents found.

has_next_page.description: Whether another page exists. Reflects the real data with both `p`/`limit` and `search_after_ctx` paging, including past the 1,000 cap of `total`. Always `false` for `POST /incident/list-by-ids`.

search_after_ctx.description: Cursor pointing at the last item of this page; pass it as `search_after_ctx` on the next request to continue past the 1,000-item page limit. Returned for every non-empty page in `p`/`limit` mode, and in cursor mode only when `has_next_page` is `true`. Omitted by `POST /incident/list-by-ids`.

IncidentRawItem.description: Raw incident row returned by the analytics incident list, with per-incident handling metrics attached.

incident_id.description: Incident ID, unique within the account.

team_id.description: ID of the team that owns the incident.

team_name.description: Name of the team that owns the incident.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel the incident belongs to.

channel_name.description: Name of the channel the incident belongs to.

created_at.description: Incident creation time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

alert_cnt.description: Total number of alerts aggregated into the incident.

active_alert_cnt.description: Number of alerts still active (not recovered).

alert_event_cnt.description: Total number of alert events associated with the incident; each report of an alert counts as one event.

closed_by.description: How the incident was closed: `auto`, `timeout`, or `manually`. Empty string while the incident is still open.

owner_id.description: Member ID of the incident owner. Omitted when 0 (no owner).

owner_name.description: Display name of the incident owner. Omitted when empty.

creator_id.description: Person ID of the incident creator.

creator_name.description: Display name of the incident creator.

closer_id.description: Member ID of the person who closed the incident. Omitted when 0 (not closed manually).

closer_name.description: Display name of the person who closed the incident. Omitted when empty.

seconds_to_ack.description: Seconds from incident creation to the first acknowledgement; 0 if never acknowledged.

seconds_to_close.description: Seconds from incident creation to close; 0 if not closed.

engaged_seconds.description: Total engaged time in seconds across acknowledged responders, each contributing close time minus their acknowledgement time; 0 if not closed.

hours.description: Time-of-day bucket of the creation time in the account timezone: `work` = Mon–Fri 08:00–19:00, `sleep` = 23:00–08:00 daily, `off` = all other times.

snoozed_before.description: Unix timestamp in seconds until which the incident is snoozed. Omitted when the incident is not snoozed.

ever_muted.description: Whether the incident was ever muted by noise reduction. Omitted when false.

frequency.description: Frequency classification: `frequent` or `rare`. Omitted when not classified.

responders.description: Responders with per-person assignment and acknowledgement times.

assigned_at.description: Assignment time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

acknowledged_at.description: Acknowledgement time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds; 0 if not acknowledged.

person_name.description: Responder display name. Omitted when empty.

as.description: Responder's identity in an external chat tool (e.g. Slack); only present when backfilled by an external system.

assigned_to.description: Current assignment target for the incident; `null` when the incident has no assignment record.

person_ids.description: Member IDs assigned directly to this incident.

escalate_rule_id.description: Escalation rule ID (MongoDB ObjectID) driving the assignment.

layer_idx.description: Current level index within the escalation rule.

type.description:
Assignment type.
| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `assign` | Initial assignment when the incident is created manually. |
| `reassign` | Re-assignment of an existing incident. |
| `escalate` | Assignment triggered by escalation policy advancement. |
| `reopen` | Assignment restarted from the first layer after the incident is reopened. |

assigned_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when this assignment was made.

labels.description: Incident labels as key-value pairs. Always omitted in this response (reserved for export).

fields.description: Custom fields of the incident. Always omitted in this response (reserved for export).

interruptions.description: Number of interruptions: notifications sent via app push, SMS, or voice call; consecutive notifications to the same responder within 60 seconds count as one.

escalations.description: Total escalations, the sum of `timeout_escalations` and `manual_escalations`.

progress.description: Incident progress: `Triggered` not yet acknowledged; `Processing` acknowledged and being handled; `Closed` resolved.

account_id.description: ID of the account the rule belongs to.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel the rule belongs to.

source_filters.description: Conditions the source alert must match, evaluated against stored active alerts. Supported keys: `status`, `incident_status`, `alert_status`, `severity`, `incident_severity`, `alert_severity`, `title`, `description`, or any `labels.<name>`. Empty makes the rule inert.

target_filters.description: Conditions the incoming target alert event must match to be inhibited; empty means every incoming event is a target. Keys: `title`, `description`, `severity` (alias `alert_severity`, `event_severity`), `status`, `alert_key`, `title_rule`, `integration_id` (alias `data_source_id`), or any `labels.<name>`.

equals.description: Keys whose values must be equal on the source alert and the incoming event. Only `title`, `severity` and `labels.<name>` take effect; with any other key the rule never fires.

is_directly_discard.description: When true, matching alert events are discarded entirely; when false, alerts are still recorded but marked as muted by this rule.

status.description: Rule status: `enabled` or `disabled`; deleted rules never appear in the list.

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the rule.

created_at.description: Creation time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

deleted_at.description: Deletion time, Unix timestamp in seconds. Omitted unless the rule is soft-deleted; deleted rules are excluded from list responses.

label.description: Aggregation key value (check name or resource identifier).

hours.description: Hour bucket when `split_hours` is enabled: `work`, `sleep`, or `off`. Omitted when `split_hours` is false.

total_alert_cnt.description: Total number of alerts in this label-value bucket.

total_alert_event_cnt.description: Total number of raw alert events in this label-value bucket.

items.description: Top-K statistic rows aggregated by the requested label's values.

InsightFilter.description: Shared filter envelope for insight and export endpoints. Severities accept up to 3 values; team/channel/responder/incident filters accept up to 100 IDs each. The time range cannot exceed one year.

start_time.description: Start time, Unix seconds. Must be greater than 0.

end_time.description: End time, Unix seconds. Must be greater than `start_time`.

team_ids.description: Filter by team IDs. At most 100 entries.

channel_ids.description: Filter by channel IDs. At most 100 entries.

responder_ids.description: Filter by responder member IDs. Used by `/insight/responder` (which responders to return) and the incident list/export (incidents any of them responded to); ignored by the account/team/channel and top-K endpoints. At most 100 entries.

severities.description: Filter by severity: `Critical`, `Warning`, `Info`, or `Ok`. At most 3 entries.

incident_ids.description: Filter by incident IDs (24-character hex). Used only by the incident list and export. At most 100 entries.

query.description: Substring match on the incident title (SQL `LIKE %query%`).

orderby.description: Sort field of the incident list; only `created_at` (incident creation time, the default). Used by `/insight/incident/list` and `/insight/incident/export`.

asc.description: Sort ascending when `true`, descending (default) otherwise. Used by the incident list and export; `/insight/alert/topk-by-label` has its own `asc`.

is_my_team.description: Restrict results to the caller's teams (intersected with `team_ids` when both are set). When that intersection is empty, or the caller belongs to no team, the result is empty.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone (for example `Asia/Shanghai` or `UTC`) used to cut `aggregate_unit` buckets; abbreviations such as `EST` and `Etc/GMT±N` are rejected. Defaults to UTC. `/insight/incident/export` uses it to render times, falling back to the account time zone and then `Asia/Shanghai`.

seconds_to_close_from.description: Lower bound (inclusive) on time-to-close, in seconds.

seconds_to_close_to.description: Upper bound (exclusive) on time-to-close, in seconds. Must be greater than `seconds_to_close_from` when both are set.

seconds_to_ack_from.description: Lower bound (inclusive) on time-to-acknowledge, in seconds.

seconds_to_ack_to.description: Upper bound (exclusive) on time-to-acknowledge, in seconds. Must be greater than `seconds_to_ack_from` when both are set.

export_fields.description: CSV column keys to include in the export, in the given order; unknown or duplicate keys are rejected. The valid key set differs per export endpoint — see each export operation's description. Only used by the export endpoints; at most 50 entries.

description_html_to_text.description: Strip HTML markup from the description column when exporting.

include_ever_muted.description: Include incidents that have ever been muted. By default, they are excluded.

allOf.description: Paged incident list request. Extends InsightFilter with pagination.

p.description: Page number, starting at 1. Used when `search_after_ctx` is not provided; `p * limit` must stay within 10,000 records.

search_after_ctx.description: Cursor token returned by a previous page (the incident ID of its last row). Pass it back to fetch the next page.

has_next_page.description: Whether another page of results is available.

items.description: Incidents on this page; an empty array when none match.

allOf.description: Insight dimension-aggregation request. Extends InsightFilter with aggregation controls.

split_hours.description: When `true`, each bucket is further split into `work`, `sleep` and `off` hours, returned as separate rows with `hours` set.

aggregate_unit.description:
Split the range into time buckets; omit for a single bucket covering the whole range. Requires a range of at least 24 hours, and `day` allows at most 31 days.
- `day`: calendar days in `time_zone` (the first bucket runs from `start_time` to the next midnight).
- `week`: consecutive 7-day buckets starting at `start_time` (not aligned to Monday).
- `month`: calendar months in `time_zone` (the first bucket runs from `start_time` to the 1st of the next month).

label.description: Aggregation dimension. `check` aggregates by the event's `labels.check` label (monitoring check); `resource` aggregates by the `labels.resource` label (monitored resource identifier).

k.description: Number of label values to return, between 1 and 100 (default 20). With `split_hours`, applied per hour bucket.

orderby.description: Sort field. `total_alert_cnt` sorts by alert count; `total_alert_event_cnt` sorts by raw alert event count (default).

LinkItem.description: Channel-level link integration reference rendered from a template.

name.description: Display name of the link.

open_type.description: How the link opens. `popup` opens it in a popup within the incident detail page; `tab` opens it in a new browser tab.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 100 when omitted.

is_my_starred.description: When true, return only channels the caller has starred. Cannot be combined with `is_my_team`.

is_my_team.description: When true, return only channels whose owning team is one of the caller's teams. Cannot be combined with `is_my_starred`.

team_ids.description: Return only channels owned by these teams. Ignored when `is_my_managed` or `is_my_team` is true.

query.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against channel name and description; invalid regex syntax falls back to a literal match. Must be valid UTF-8 — invalid byte sequences are rejected with `InvalidParameter`.

channel_name.description: Exact-match filter on channel name. Takes priority over `query` for name filtering. Must be valid UTF-8 — invalid byte sequences are rejected with `InvalidParameter`.

items.description: Channels on the current page.

total.description: Total number of matching channels across all pages.

has_next_page.description: Whether more pages follow. Reliable only when `p` is passed.
