message.description: Test failure message; empty on success.

plugin_type.description: Integration type. Must be one listed by `POST /integration/type/list` with `supports_api_create: true`.

name.description: Integration name, 2–49 characters when nonempty; defaults to the integration type name when omitted or empty.

team_id.description: Owning team ID; omit or use `0` for no team. A nonzero ID must belong to the current account.

settings.description: Type-specific configuration; the accepted keys depend on `plugin_type`.

integration_key.description: Optional pre-generated key: 35 characters, ending with the account ID modulo 1000 padded to three digits; it must not already be in use. Omit to generate a key.

is_test.description: Run the plugin test during creation; false when omitted. Inspect the returned `test.success` for the test outcome.

CreateIntegrationResponse.description: The created integration and its key.

integration_id.description: ID of the new integration.

integration_key.description: Integration key for inbound pushes; also readable from `/integration/list` and `/integration/info`.

test.description: Plugin test result, returned only when a test is performed.

message.description: Test failure message; empty on success.

UpdateIntegrationRequest.description: Payload for updating an integration. Only the fields you send are changed.

integration_id.description: ID of a public integration, returned by `POST /integration/list`. An unknown ID or a channel-owned integration returns `ResourceNotFound`.

name.description: New name, 2–49 characters.

team_id.description: New owning team ID; `0` clears the team assignment.

settings.description: Replacement type-specific configuration. Known sensitive fields omitted or sent as `******` keep their stored value; an explicit empty headers object clears headers. A stored secret cannot be kept while its destination (such as `endpoint`, `url`, or a database host or port) changes.

is_test.description: Run the plugin test when submitting `settings`; no test is performed for a metadata-only update.

IntegrationLifecycleRequest.description: Identifies the integration to act on.

integration_id.description: ID of a public integration, returned by `POST /integration/list`. An unknown ID or a channel-owned integration returns `ResourceNotFound`.

integration_key.description: New integration key; the previous key stops working immediately.

WorkItemAssignee.description: One assignee on a work item.

id.description: Member ID. Required when `type` is `person`. Omitted when `type` is `ai_sre`.

type.description: Assignee kind: `person` (a member) or `ai_sre` (the account AI SRE).

AlertEvent.description: One raw alert event, in the shape the ingestion pipeline receives and stores.

title.description: Event title. Required unless `title_rule` is set; the two are the source of the alert title.

title_rule.description: Title template such as `$service::$alertname`, built from `labels` when `title` is empty.

alert_key.description: Deduplication key that merges events into one alert. Empty is allowed: the preview mints a random key, so nothing is merged.

event_status.description: Event status. `Critical`, `Warning` and `Info` are firing events; `Ok` is a recovery.

event_severity.description: Severity carried by a firing event. The preview overwrites it with `event_status` for firing events.

event_time.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. The preview stamps the current time, so the value sent is ignored.

labels.description: Event labels. Up to 50 entries; keys are label names, values strings.

EnrichmentPreviewEvent.description: The event as the enrichment preview saw it.

title.description: Event title after the steps applied so far.

labels.description: Label set after the steps applied so far.

EnrichmentSample.description: One raw event an integration received, as it entered enrichment.

received_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds of when the integration received the event.

event.description: The raw event, before any enrichment rule ran.

description_truncated.description: `true` when the stored description was cut to the sample size limit.

dropped.description: `true` when the integration discarded the event before it became an alert. Omitted when `false`.

EnrichStep.description: What one enrichment rule did to the event.

index.description: Zero-based position of the rule in `rules`.

kind.description:
Rule type that ran.
| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `extraction` | Extract a value from the alert's `title`, `description` or a `labels.*` key and write it to a label. |
| `composition` | Render a template against the event and write the result to a label. |
| `mapping` | Look up labels from a mapping schema or an external mapping API. |
| `drop` | Remove the listed labels from the alert. |

matched.description: Whether the rule's `if` conditions all matched. `false` means the rule changed nothing.

skipped_reason.description: Why the rule was skipped: `condition_not_met`, `regex_not_matched`, `source_label_missing`, `mapping_row_not_found`, `result_label_exists` or `error`. Empty when the rule ran.

detail.description: Rule-specific detail: the matched mapping row, the rendered value, or the error message when `skipped_reason` is `error`.

added.description: Labels the rule wrote that were not there before. `null` when it added none.

removed.description: Labels the rule deleted. `null` when it removed none.

changed.description: Labels the rule rewrote, each as a `[old_value, new_value]` pair. `null` when it rewrote none.

mapping_row.description: The mapping row the rule matched. `null` for a rule that is not a mapping rule or matched no row.

AlertPipelinePreviewEvent.description: The event as the pipeline preview saw it.

severity.description: Severity the event carried at this point.

PipelineStep.description: What one alert processing rule did to the event.

index.description: Zero-based position of the rule in `rules`.

kind.description:
Rule type that ran.
| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `title_reset` | Rewrote the title from the rule's template. |
| `description_reset` | Rewrote the description from the rule's template. |
| `severity_reset` | Reset the severity and status to the rule's `severity`. |
| `alert_drop` | Discarded the event; no alert is created. |
| `alert_inhibit` | Discarded the event while a matching source alert is active. |

result.description: Outcome of the rule: `applied` (it changed the event or stopped the pipeline), `not_matched` (its `if` conditions did not all match), or `not_executed` (an earlier rule stopped the pipeline, or the event is a recovery).

detail.description: `condition_not_met`, `no_active_source_alert`, `inhibit_not_evaluated` or `recovery_event` for those outcomes; otherwise the resulting value or the error message.

AlertEmailPreviewSettings.description: Email integration settings to preview, in the shape the save endpoint accepts.

mode.description:
How the integration decides what an email becomes. Omitted defaults to `alwaysTrigger`.
- `alwaysTrigger`: every email becomes its own alert, keyed randomly.
- `triggerByTitle`: every email becomes a firing event whose alert key is hashed from the subject.
- `triggerOrCloseByRule`: `rules` decide whether an email triggers, closes or is discarded, and `default` handles the rest.

rules.description: Rules tried in order when `mode` is `triggerOrCloseByRule`; each entry must be a non-empty object. At most 50.

default.description: What happens to an email that matches no rule when `mode` is `triggerOrCloseByRule`: `trigger` turns it into a firing event, `discard` drops it.

AlertEmailRule.description: One rule that matches an email and extracts the alert key from it.

type.description: `trigger` turns a matching email into a firing event, `close` into a recovery event.

extract_from.description: Which part of the email the alert key is extracted from: `title` or `description`. For `description` the body text is searched first, then the body text with tables, then the description.

extract_pattern.description: Regular expression the key is extracted with; the captured groups are joined by `,` to form the key source. A pattern that captures nothing falls back to the subject.

filters.description: AND conditions the email must match for the rule to apply. Send `[]` to match every email.

AlertEmailPreviewEmail.description: The email to run the preview over.

body.description: Email body: HTML when it starts with `<`, otherwise plain text.

eml.description: A whole email file (`.eml`) as base64. When set it stands in for `subject`, `body` and `from` and is parsed the way the SMTP server parses mail.

AlertEmailPreviewEvent.description: The alert event the email would have produced.

event_status.description: Status of the event this email produces.

event_severity.description: Severity of a firing event; empty for a recovery.

labels.description: Labels taken from the email: the body, sender, recipients and subject are exposed as labels.

AlertEmailPreviewParsed.description: The email as the conversion read it.

subject.description: Subject as the parser decoded it.

from.description: Sender address taken from the email.

body.description: Body the conversion used: the HTML part when there is one, otherwise the text part.

body_text.description: Body as plain text; a key extracted from the description is looked for here first.

integration_id.description: Integration whose context the preview runs in. The rules you send are not saved.

rules.description: Enrichment rules to try, in order. At most 50. The integration's stored rules are not used.

event.description: The event to run the rules over.

after.description: The event after the rules ran, with the `[TPL]` labels, title and description of a firing event rendered.

steps.description: One entry per rule, in the order they ran.

integration_id.description: Integration whose recent raw events to list.

EnrichmentSampleListResponse.description: Recent raw events of one integration.

items.description: Samples, newest first. Empty when no event has arrived yet.

integration_id.description: Integration whose saved enrichment runs first and whose pipeline context the preview uses.

rules.description: Alert processing rules to try, in order. At most 50. The integration's stored pipeline is not used.

event.description: The event to run the rules over.

is_recovery.description: `true` when the event is a recovery event: ingestion closes the alert without running the pipeline.

after.description: The event as notification templates would render it once the rules ran.

dropped.description: `true` when a rule dropped the event, so no alert would be created.

inhibited.description: `true` when a rule inhibited the event because a matching source alert is active.

steps.description: One entry per rule, in the order they ran.

integration_id.description: Email integration whose saved settings seed the preview. `0` or omitted is what the console sends on the create page, before the integration exists.

settings.description: Settings to preview. They are validated the way the save endpoint validates them.

AlertEmailPreviewResponse.description: How the settings treated the email, plus what the conversion read.

result.description: What the settings make of this email: `trigger` (a firing event), `close` (a recovery event) or `discard` (dropped).

matched_rule.description: Zero-based index of the rule that matched. `null` when no rule matched, and always `null` in `alwaysTrigger` and `triggerByTitle` modes.

key_source.description: What the alert key was hashed from. Empty when every email is its own alert (`alwaysTrigger`) or the email is discarded.

key_fallback.description: `true` when the rule's pattern captured nothing and the subject was used as the key source.

alert_key.description: Hash of `key_source`. Empty in `alwaysTrigger` mode, where each email gets a random key.

event.description: The event the email produces. `null` when the email is discarded.

email.description: What the conversion read from the email. `null` when the email could not be parsed.

ChannelIntegrationItem.description: A channel-owned dedicated integration, with its complete key and masked settings.

integration_id.description: Dedicated integration ID; use this ID for subsequent API calls.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel that owns the dedicated integration.

integration_key.description: Complete integration key for alert ingestion; separate from the management App Key.

exclusive_data_source_id.description: Compatibility identifier for earlier integrations; `0` when absent. Use `integration_id` for this API group.

plugin_id.description: Numeric integration type ID. Create uses the string `plugin_type` instead.

plugin_type_name.description: Integration type display name, localized to the request language.

category.description: Integration category; dedicated integration creation accepts `event.alert` alert integrations.

name.description: Integration name.

status.description: Lifecycle status: `enabled` accepts alerts; `disabled` pauses ingestion.

created_at.description: Creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

last_time.description: Most recent received-event time as a Unix timestamp in seconds; `0` when no event has arrived.

last_source_time.description: Source time of the most recent event as a Unix timestamp in seconds; `0` when unavailable.

settings.description: Integration-type-specific configuration; saved secret values in responses are masked as `******`.

integration_id.description: Dedicated integration ID returned by create, list, or info. Public integration IDs are not accepted.

ChannelIntegrationListRequest.description: Filters and pagination for one channel's dedicated integrations.

channel_id.description: Channel ID to list dedicated integrations for.

limit.description: Number of items per page, at most 100.

name.description: Filter by integration name.

status.description: Filter by `enabled` integrations that accept alerts or `disabled` integrations that pause ingestion.

total.description: Total number of matching dedicated integrations.

items.description: Dedicated integrations on this page.

ChannelIntegrationCreateRequest.description: Creates a dedicated integration in an enabled channel.

channel_id.description: Target channel ID; the channel must be enabled.

plugin_type.description: Enabled alert integration type identifier, such as `standard.alert`.

name.description: Integration name, 2–49 characters when supplied; omitted or empty uses the integration type default.

integration_key.description: Optional supplied integration key. A non-empty value must have 35 characters, match the account suffix, and be unique.

settings.description: Integration-type-specific configuration; saved secret values in responses are masked as `******`.

integration_id.description: Created dedicated integration ID.

name.description: New name, 2–49 characters; omitted or null keeps the stored name.

description.description: New description, at most 499 characters; empty clears it, omitted or null keeps it.
